senses.gloss:
mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
1 Perceptible, present to the senses.
2 Superintending, presiding over.
m. (-क्षः)
1 A superintendent in general, one of receipts and disbursements.
2 A plant, (a species of Mimusops.) See क्षीरिका.
E.
अधि, and अक्ष to pervade, with अच् aff.

f. (-ता)
Superintendence: also अध्यक्षत्व. n. (-त्वं)
E.
ता or त्व added to the last.

n. (रं)
The mysterious word Om.
E.
अधि, and अक्षर letter: above all others in importance or in place; being often put at the head of various writings.

ind.
Gifts made to a woman at the time of her marriage.
E.
अधि near, over, &c. and अग्नि fire, being presented at the time that burnt offerings are made.

f. (-ण्डा)
Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.)
E.
अधि, अम to be diseased, and ड affix; superior to disease. See अव्यंगा.

m. (-यः)
A lecture, a chapter or section.
E.
अधि before इक् to go, अङ् aff.

m. (-यः)
1 The section, or division of a book.
2 A chapter or lecture of the Vedas.
E.
अधि, इङ to go, and घञ् aff. proper to be gone through or read.

n. (-नं)
Study, reading, especially of the sacred books; one of the six duties of a Brahman.
E.
अधि, इङ् to go, and ल्युट् aff.

m. (-यः)
Effort, exertion, determined application.
E.
अधि, and अव before षो to destroy, with the affixes घञ् and यक्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Undertaken, attempted, as a difficult task.
E.
अधि, and अव before षो, affix क्त.

mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि)
Resolute, determined.
E.
अध्यवसाय, and इनि aff.

n. (-नं)
Eating too often, taking food before that previously eaten is digested.
E.
अधि, and अशन eating.

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Substituted.
2 Placed over.
E.
अधि, and अस्त thrown.

n. (-स्थि)
Bony exfoliation or deposit.
E.
अधि, and अस्थि a bone.

m. (-त्मा)
1 The soul, individuated spirit, or that which belongs to and presides over the body.
2 The supreme spirit.
E.
अधि, and आत्मन् self or soul.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Spiritual, relating to the supreme spirit.
E.
अध्यात्मन् and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to the supreme spirit, spiritual, holy.
E.
अध्यात्म the soul, and ठङ् aff.

m. (-दृक्)
A holy sage, one who knows the nature of inherent spirit.
E.
अध्यात्मन, and दृश् who sees.

m. (-तिः)
An anchorite, one who diligently meditates on the supreme spirit.
E.
अध्यात्मन्, and रति pleasure.

m. (-कः)
A teacher, one who instructs in the sacred books.
E.
अधि, and इङ् to go, in the causal form, and वुन् aff.

m. (-कः)
A teacher, a scriptural preceptor.
E.
आङ्, prefixed to the causal of अधी to peruse, affix वुन्.

n. (-नं)
Instructing, teaching the sacred books; one of the six duties of a Brahman.
E.
अधि, इङ to go, in the causal form, and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Taught.
E.
अधीङ and क्त aff.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Mounted on, riding upon.
2 Exceeding, very much.
E.
अधि, and आङ before रुह to become manifest, affix क्त.

m. (-पः)
See the next.

n. (-णं)
1 Fixing in or upon.
2 Transferring.
3 Attaching erroneously the predicates of one object to another, as of eternity to matter, &c.
E.
अधि before रुह to grow, causal form ल्युट् affix, also with घञ् affix अध्यारोपः.

m. (-हः)
Mounting or ascending.
E.
अधि, and आङ before रुह to rise, affix घञ्.

n. (-ण)
Ascending, mounting on or upon.
E.
अधि and आङ before रुह to rise, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-कं)
A woman's marriage portion, a dowry of such property as has descended to her lineally.
E.
अधि and आङ before वह to convey, ल्युट् affix, and ठक added.

n. (-सं)
1 Inhabiting as chief, residing in, presiding over or ruling.
2 Sitting on or upon.
3 Transferring.
4 Attributing erroneously the nature of one thing to another, as of eternity to matter, &c.
E.
अधि before, आस sit, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Seated in or on.
2 Presiding over.
3 Inhabited.
E.
अधि before, आस to sit, क्त aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Seated in or on.
2 Placed or presiding over.
E.
अधि before, आसीन seated.

n. (-णं)
1 Supplying an ellipsis.
2 Reasoning, discussing.
E.
अधि, आङ prefixed to हृञ to convey, with ल्युट् aff.

m. (-रः)
1 Adding a word or words to complete a sentence, supplying an ellipsis.
2 Reasoning, argument.
E.
See अध्याहरण, घञ् being the aff.

mfn. (-र्य्यः-र्य्या-र्य्यं)
1 Investigable.
2 Requiring an ellipsis to be supplied.
E.
अधि, and आङ before हृ to take, ण्यत् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Supplied as an ellipsis.
2 Argued, discussed.
E.
अधि and आङ before हृ to take, क्त aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Inhabited, settled.
E.
अधि before वस to dwell, affix क्त.

m. (-ष्ट्रः)
A litter drawn or carried by a camel.
E.
अधि, and उष्ट्र a camel.

mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
1 Very prosperous, thriving.
2 Much.
m. (-ढः)
A name of ŚIVA.
f. (-ढा)
A superseded wife, one whose husband has married others.
E.
अधि, and ऊढ borne, from वह to bear, affix क्त.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
A student, reading, studying.
E.
अधि before इङ to go, शतृ aff.

f. (-णा)
1 Request, solicitation.
2 Asking, begging.
E.
अधि, इष to wish, and ल्यु aff.

f. (-ध्या)
Recollection, remembering especially with regret.
E.
आङ् before ध्यै to reflect, अच् affix, and ठाप् fem.

n. (-नं)
Remembering, pensive or sorrowful recollection, dwelling or meditating upon, &c.
E.
आङ्, ध्यै to consider, and ल्युट् aff.

m. (-गः)
Usufruct of a pledge.
E.
आधि and उपभोग enjoyment.
